text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Starting today, my trainee and I will be taking on the Twinkle Series. The Umamusume joining me for this journey is none other than…

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: I am Symboli Rudolf. I look forward to working hand in glove with you.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: …My goal is to establish a world in which every single Umamusume lives in bliss. To this end, I must produce results befitting the Emperor who would guide them all.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Let us walk this hallowed, imperial path together, gathering the prestigious crowns that mark it as we make for its ultimate destination.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And so, <chrname> and I take our first steps towards competing in the Twinkle Series!
